question: When the Israelites cried out because of Midian, the LORD first sent a prophet. What was the main message?
options: They should build a temple in Jerusalem
The LORD told them not to worship the gods of the Amorites, but they had not listened
They should choose a king to lead them
They should go back to Egypt
explanation: The prophet reminded Israel that the LORD had brought them out of Egypt and told them not to worship the gods of the Amorites, but they had not listened.
